WITH base AS (
  SELECT st.healtheval AS status,
         s.scancount,
         s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0) AS ratio
  FROM scans s
  JOIN sites st ON st.zoneregistry = s.zoneref
  WHERE s.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274'
    AND s.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
),
status_stats AS (
  SELECT status,
         SUM(scancount) AS total_scans,
         AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM base
  GROUP BY status
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM status_stats
)
SELECT ss.status,
       ss.total_scans,
       ss.avg_ratio,
       ss.avg_ratio - o.mean_ratio AS deviation_from_mean
FROM status_stats ss
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE o.mean_ratio IS NOT NULL;
